checks.name: ios_audio_session_owner_and_policy_source_audit

environment.runtime: NOT_RUN; CoreSimulatorService inventory failed and no physical iPhone is available in this environment

checks.observation: The app disables flutter_webrtc audio-session management and uses LiveKit’s engine observer to configure/activate the session from engine state. The default communication policy is playAndRecord/videoChat with Bluetooth/A2DP/AirPlay routing; UIBackgroundModes includes audio. The local wrapper does not register its own AVAudioSession interruption observer; audio interruption handling is delegated to the pinned WebRTC framework. The upstream RTCAudioSession interface states that WebRTC handles AVAudioSession notifications before optional application delegate callbacks; upstream source shows interruption, route, media-services-reset and app-active handling.
limitations: The pinned WebRTC-SDK binary is not vendored for exact-source inspection; the upstream RTCAudioSession contract cannot substitute for runtime behavior of that binary.
No physical interruption, route-change, media-services-reset, background/lock or 60-minute paired audio scenario was run.
The iOS Simulator SDK is present, but the host CoreSimulatorService refused device/runtime enumeration during this audit.
